questions.q: How do I choose a tax preparer?
questions.a: Look for credentials such as a CPA, an attorney or an enrolled agent, and verify them with the state licensing board or the IRS. Many big-box preparers are seasonal workers without an accounting background.
Ask for a quote up front. Prices vary with how complex the return is, the location and the preparer's experience. We have no hidden fees.

questions.q: What should I check before I sign?
questions.a: Review the return before signing it, and make sure the preparer signs it too and includes a Preparer Tax Identification Number.

services.title: 401(k) Strategies
services.text: We actively manage how your 401k funds are invested, adjusting the mix as markets move rather than leaving it to sit.
services.lead: The greatest key to the success of your 401k is consistent and ongoing contributions. We work to minimize your losses in a bear market and maximize your growth as the market rebounds.

covers.title: Active management
covers.text: How the funds are invested is adjusted as markets change, instead of being left static.

covers.title: Downturns
covers.text: Shifting into cash-like holdings when the market falls can lock in the loss. We manage the decline rather than react to it.

covers.title: Contributions
covers.text: Keep contributing through a downturn. Buying at lower prices can help the account recover.

covers.title: Asset allocation
covers.text: The right mix depends on when you retire and more. A 60% stock and 40% bond split is a common balanced starting point, tailored to your individual needs.

about.title: A CPA firm built around the small businesses of northeast Harris County.
text: Silver Accounting Group, LLC and SG Wealth LLC provide a full range of wealth management, tax, accounting, bookkeeping, consulting, payroll and business services. The work is done in the Humble office or remotely and online, whichever suits you.

Brian Silver founded the firm in 2019, when he transitioned from corporate management to public accounting. Financial controls, security and compliance were key responsibilities as a senior executive and consultant to Fortune 500 companies, and he brought that work to the firms on this side of Houston.

We serve the Humble area, northeast Harris County and Montgomery County along the 59, 99 and 249 corridors. There are over 28 million small businesses in the United States, and supporting them supports the country's financial infrastructure. When small business wins, everyone wins.
